highlights.page: Since July 2026: core engineer on Sentinel, Vidal Health's new motor insurance platform, built for several countries and first rolled out for a client in Qatar. One Java 25, Spring Boot 4 and Spring Modulith application covers quoting, underwriting, issuance, endorsements, claims, billing and reinsurance. Co-lead parts of its architecture, domain entities and deployment, from VMs provisioned with Ansible to Azure Pipelines deploys on a multi-node Docker Swarm cluster.

Co-lead parts of its architecture, domain entities and deployment (VMs provisioned with Ansible, Azure Pipelines to a multi-node Docker Swarm cluster).
highlights.llms: Since July 2026, core engineer on Sentinel, Vidal Health's motor insurance platform, built for several countries and first rolled out for a client in Qatar. One Java 25, Spring Boot 4 and Spring Modulith application covers quoting, underwriting, issuance, endorsements, claims, billing and reinsurance. Co-leads parts of its architecture, domain entities and deployment (VMs provisioned with Ansible, Azure Pipelines to a multi-node Docker Swarm cluster).

highlights.text: Built Sentinel's pricing rule engine (risk-based rate tables, depreciation, add-ons, third-party tariffs). Fixed a production 504 spike, where median latency had grown from 7–10 s to 63–82 s, by cutting fleet-pricing database queries from about 216 to 1–3 per vehicle and halving payment-start validation passes.
Added a GraalVM native-image build that cut memory by about 79% (2.36 GiB to 494 MiB). CI fails a build on module-boundary drift, field-dictionary violations or a route without JWT protection.

Own claims end to end across the customer, garage and surveyor portals (first notice of loss, estimates, LPO checklists, transfer-letter PDFs, status tracking), and integrated hosted card checkout with webhook routing.
highlights.llms: Owns claims end to end across the customer, garage and surveyor portals (first notice of loss, estimates, LPO checklists, transfer-letter PDFs, status tracking), and integrated hosted card checkout with webhook routing.

highlights.text: Run Sentinel's production deploys on Docker Swarm (several replicas, start-first rollouts with automatic rollback), send OpenTelemetry to ClickStack, and moved runtime secrets to OpenBao with each stack kept separate.
highlights.llms: Runs Sentinel's production deploys on Docker Swarm (several replicas, start-first rollouts with automatic rollback), sends OpenTelemetry to ClickStack, and moved runtime secrets to OpenBao with each stack kept separate.

highlights.page: 2023 to 2026: main engineer on the integration layer, a Java 21 and Spring Boot service in front of Salesforce Vlocity for policies, claims, benefits, issuance and product sync. It talks to other systems through Kafka events, and retry topics and dead-letter queues mean a failed event is either tried again or parked for replay. Redis caching cut policy status lookups from 2.3 s to 91 ms.
highlights.resume: Main engineer on the integration layer (2023 to 2026): a Java 21 / Spring Boot service in front of Salesforce Vlocity for policies, claims, benefits, issuance and product sync, connected to other systems through Kafka with retry topics and dead-letter queues. Redis caching cut policy status lookups from 2.3 s to 91 ms.
highlights.llms: From 2023 to 2026, main engineer on the integration layer: a Java 21 and Spring Boot service in front of Salesforce Vlocity for policies, claims, benefits, issuance and product sync, connected to other systems through Kafka with retry topics and dead-letter queues. Redis caching cut policy status lookups from 2.3 s to 91 ms.

highlights.text: Moved I/O-bound APIs, Kafka consumers and scheduled jobs onto Java 21 virtual threads, including endpoints that call several downstream APIs in parallel. Replaced synchronized blocks with ReentrantLock to stop carrier-thread pinning and kept trace IDs intact. Peak burst capacity went up about 5x, average production latency fell 36% (286 to 182 ms), and cascading hung-thread 504s stopped.
Built the gRPC bridge that subscribes to Salesforce Platform Events (replay-ID recovery, token refresh, single-pod readiness) and the Kafka processor behind it, with dead-letter handling.

Replaced wkhtmltopdf with a pooled headless Chromium service for claim letters and welcome kits (recycling on failure, dead-letter topics, graceful shutdown), deployed through ArgoCD. In a load test at 20 concurrent users, p95 was 2.6 s with 0.26% errors.

Owned Azure API Management across dev, UAT and prod: JWT policies, per-IP rate limits of 1,000 requests a minute set from observed peaks of 850–870, and OpenAPI specs published from CI. Added full-body payload encryption on cashless APIs, Resilience4j circuit breakers and ShedLock for single-pod jobs.
Improved tracing across services with Spring Boot advice and custom interceptors that propagate trace IDs, and that also handle payload encryption and a standard response format.
highlights.page: Improved tracing across services with Spring Boot advice and custom interceptors that pass trace IDs along. The same interceptors handle payload encryption and a standard response format.
Cut service startup time roughly in half by changing how the application initializes and tuning Kubernetes liveness and readiness probes. Other services adopted the same approach.
highlights.resume: Cut service startup time roughly in half through application-initialization changes and Kubernetes liveness/readiness probe tuning; other services adopted the same approach.
highlights.llms: Cut service startup time roughly in half through application-initialization changes and Kubernetes liveness and readiness probe tuning. Other services adopted the same approach.

highlights.text: Shipped NestJS and Kafka fulfilment pipelines for Niva Bupa, HDFC and ABHI, SSO and issuance flows for PeopleStrong and Tata AIG, and encryption SDK samples for partners in Java, Android, iOS and React Native.

projects.name: Crossroom
projects.llms: Puts up to six AI agents in one room, each working from its own files, and keeps the recap. Live and in active development (formerly called Parley). Agents from different vendors join through seat links or MCP; excerpts they share carry their source paths, and the minutes are rendered from the event log. Each room is encrypted at rest under its own key, with optional end-to-end encryption. Crossroom Code runs Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Grok as chats on your own computer and lets another device carry on with them. TypeScript, Hono, MCP SDK, SQLite, React.

resume.description: Puts up to six AI agents from different vendors in one room, each working from its own files. Shared excerpts carry their source paths, the minutes are rendered from the event log, and each room is encrypted at rest under its own key.
highlights: Agents join from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI or any MCP client, and can split a change across repositories or hand work to each other.
Ships as a web app, an open-source CLI on npm and Homebrew, a VS Code extension, TypeScript and Python SDKs and an Android app.

projects.name: TeamTakes
projects.llms: Opinionated polls and play-money prediction games for engineering teams. Live. Each team gets its own subdomain, and row-level security in Postgres (self-hosted Supabase) limits every query to the user's own teams. A leak test checks that one team can't read or change another team's data. Built with TanStack Start (React 19), Docker Compose, Traefik and Cloudflare.

resume.description: Opinionated polls and play-money prediction games for engineering teams. Live.
highlights: Made the app multi-tenant while it was in use, with each team on its own subdomain.
Row-level security in Postgres limits every query to the user's own teams, and a leak test checks that one team can't read or change another team's data.
Most of the game logic, including market pricing and the points ledger, runs in Postgres functions, with pg_cron handling scheduled rounds.
